name: junglescout_sales_estimate
description: How many units does an Amazon ASIN sell — returns Jungle Scout estimated units sold, revenue, and price for a product ASIN. Example: junglescout_sales_estimate({ asin: "B08N5WRWNW", marketplace: "us", _apiKey: "KEY_NAME:API_KEY" })

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace country code (default "us"). One of: us, uk, de, in, ca, fr, it, es, mx, jp

start_date.description: Optional range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to ~30 days ago.

end_date.description: Optional range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

_apiKey.description: Jungle Scout credential as "KEY_NAME:API_KEY" (both parts, colon-joined) from your Developer page. Requires the API add-on.

name: junglescout_product_database
description: Search Amazon products by keyword or category — returns matching ASINs with title, brand, price, rank, estimated units sold, reviews, and rating from the Jungle Scout product database. Example: junglescout_product_database({ keyword: "yoga mat", marketplace: "us", _apiKey: "KEY_NAME:API_KEY" })

keyword.description: Keyword/phrase products must include, e.g. "yoga mat"

category.description: Amazon category to filter by, e.g. "Sports & Outdoors". Pass keyword and/or category.

name: junglescout_keyword_data
description: Amazon keyword search volume — returns monthly search volume and keyword metrics for a keyword, or the top keywords an ASIN ranks for. Pass `keyword` OR `asin`. Example: junglescout_keyword_data({ keyword: "yoga mat", marketplace: "us", _apiKey: "KEY_NAME:API_KEY" })

keyword.description: Seed keyword to look up search volume for, e.g. "yoga mat"

asin.description: Alternatively, an ASIN — returns the keywords that product ranks for
